title: Quaternionic LVM Manifolds
summary: An admissible configuration $Λ\subset\Hh^m\simeq\Rr^{4m}$ defines a compact intersection of quadrics $Z_{\Hh}(Λ)$ and a free diagonal $\Sp(1)$ quotient $N_{\Hh}(Λ)$. We realize this quotient as the leaf space of a real dilation action on an open subset of quaternionic projective space. The total space is a quaternionic moment-angle polyhedral product. Every quotient is $2$-connected; when there are no indispensable coordinates, it is $3$-connected and its fourth integral cohomology is generated by the Euler class $e$ of the associated oriented rank-four bundle.
